Quick Oven Fries
By: Mimi Cooks
Published: Wednesday, January 6, 2010 - 10:08am

Ingredients




Few pieces of Potatoes

Olive oil

Salt and black pepper to taste

Dry Oregano, Optional

Preparation

1 Heat up the oven to high heat 2 Slice the potatoes thin slices 3 Mix all the above ingredients and mix well with the potatoes in a baking pan 4 Bake in the hot oven for 30-40 minutes until the edges are browned and the top is golden

About


This is a very easy and tasty recipe for Fries. The only difference is that these fries are not deep fried, they are baked in the oven. This way you can enjoy eating them without feeling guilty about the extra calories and fat content. Enjoy!
